tasks.subject: Task 1 (D1): Capability payload hash/version binding + cache
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Make the embeddable-Python-zip and browser-binary downloads hash-bound and reference-counted, the way Slice 3 already made app-source releases -- today `bootstrap/downloader.py::download()` supports `expected_sha256`/`expected_size` but neither `bootstrap/python_env.py` nor `bootstrap/browser_setup.py` passes them, and `bootstrap/capability_cache.py`'s `CacheManifest` is implemented but never called.

**Files:**
- Create: `bootstrap/capability_manifest.py`
- Modify: `bootstrap/python_env.py`
- Modify: `bootstrap/browser_setup.py`
- Test: `tests/launcher/test_capability_manifest.py`, `tests/launcher/test_capability_wiring.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `CapabilityManifest` round-trips through JSON with os/arch fields populated from platform.system()/platform.machine() at build time
- [ ] `_download_and_extract_python` fails and deletes the partial download when the hash doesn't match the manifest
- [ ] A successful Python-zip or Chromium install records a capability_cache reference against the current release version
- [ ] `capability_cache.evict_unreferenced` gets called somewhere real in the update path (not just unit-tested standalone)
- [ ] A payload whose manifest os/arch doesn't match the current platform is never downloaded

**Verify:** `uv run pytest -q tests/launcher/test_capability_manifest.py tests/launcher/test_capability_wiring.py tests/launcher/test_capability_cache.py -v` → all pass

See `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-22-slice-4-installer-capabilities-hardening.md` (Task 1 / D1) for full RED-test code, implementation, and recovery path.

```json:metadata

  "files": [

    "bootstrap/capability_manifest.py",

    "tests/launcher/test_capability_wiring.py"
  ],
  "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest -q tests/launcher/test_capability_manifest.py tests/launcher/test_capability_wiring.py tests/launcher/test_capability_cache.py -v",
  "acceptanceCriteria": [
```

tasks.subject: Task 2 (D2): Fix macOS winreg import blocker + browser sele
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `bootstrap.main` is unimportable on macOS today -- confirmed this session: `python3 -c "import bootstrap.main"` raises `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'winreg'` because `bootstrap/webview2.py` does a module-level `import winreg`. Fix that first (it blocks every later macOS-touching task in this plan), then extend `bootstrap/browser_setup.py` to macOS (Chrome->managed Chromium), plus a gated experimental Safari path and a readiness check.

**Files:**
- Modify: `bootstrap/webview2.py`
- Modify: `bootstrap/browser_setup.py`
- Create: `bootstrap/probe_chrome_macos.py`, `bootstrap/probe_safari.py`
- Test: `tests/launcher/test_webview2_macos_import.py`, `tests/launcher/test_browser_selection.py`, `tests/integration/test_browser_readiness.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `python3 -c "import bootstrap.main"` succeeds on macOS
- [ ] webview2's registry-hive functions still work correctly on Windows
- [ ] On macOS, resolve_browser_channel tries Chrome before falling back to managed Chromium
- [ ] Safari is never selected automatically -- only reachable via an explicit experimental path with a truthful warning
- [ ] The selected engine completes a loopback readiness transaction before being ready; failure never triggers an engine-switch fallback
- [ ] SCOUTMB_FORCE_CHROMIUM_FALLBACK works identically on the new macOS probe

**Verify:** `uv run pytest -q tests/launcher/test_webview2_macos_import.py tests/launcher/test_browser_selection.py tests/integration/test_browser_readiness.py -v` → all pass (run at least once on a real macOS host)

tasks.subject: Task 3 (D3): Local immutable capability-payload lifecycle
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the full "first install -> interrupted resume -> update -> offline restart" cycle for capability payloads (not just app source, which C7 already proved), against a local fake payload source -- no network, no hosted channel (still POSTPONED).

**Files:**
- Create: `tests/fakes/local_capability_source.py`
- Modify: `bootstrap/main.py::_run`
- Test: `tests/integration/test_capability_install_lifecycle.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] First install stages and hash-verifies every declared capability payload before marking install complete
- [ ] Interrupting between two payload downloads and rerunning resumes correctly (no re-download of already-verified payloads)
- [ ] An update that fails partway leaves the N capability set fully intact and referenced
- [ ] After a successful update, restart with no real network reachable still launches against the staged N+1 set
- [ ] CapabilityManifest.source_url is a plain swappable string field, nothing assumes a specific hosting mechanism

**Verify:** `uv run pytest -q tests/integration/test_capability_install_lifecycle.py -v` → all pass

See `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-22-slice-4-installer-capabilities-hardening.md` (Task 3 / D3) for full RED-test code, implementation, and recovery path.

tasks.subject: Task 4 (D4): Native thin ≤18MB Windows & macOS installers
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add a macOS build path -- there is none today. `bootstrap/build.spec` hardcodes winreg/bootstrap.webview2 unconditionally in hiddenimports, which cannot resolve on macOS. Blocked on D2 landing first. ci.yml's existing coverage-baseline job (runs on macos-latest successfully) is treated as confirmed macOS Actions capacity -- no separate runner setup task.

**Files:**
- Modify: `bootstrap/build.spec`
- Create: `.github/workflows/release.yml`
- Test: `tests/release/test_installer_budget.py`, `tests/release/test_clean_machine.py`, `tests/ci/test_release_workflow.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] build.spec builds successfully on macOS (requires D2 landed first)
- [ ] Each native installer is at most 18 MB
- [ ] Neither installer embeds Playwright/browser/OpenCV/PDF/wheelhouse
- [ ] A clean machine (no system Python) installs core via either installer and launches fully offline afterward
- [ ] release.yml's two jobs each run only on their native runner, no cross-build
- [ ] Windows 10 x64 is best-effort only, never blocks the release job

**Verify:** `uv run pytest -q tests/release/ tests/ci/test_release_workflow.py -v` → all pass; trigger release.yml manually once on both runners before merging

tasks.subject: Task 5 (D5): Redacted rotating diagnostics + no-op telemetr
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `bootstrap/main.py::_setup_logging` already builds a real non-rotating logger. Add rotation + redaction, extend structured logging into src/scoutmb replacing the 19 print() diagnostic sites (user-facing progress prints stay as print()), and add ObservabilityPort/NoopObservability following the ports/clock.py Protocol convention.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/scoutmb/logging_setup.py`, `src/scoutmb/ports/observability.py`, `src/scoutmb/adapters/observability/noop.py`
- Modify: `bootstrap/main.py::_setup_logging`

- Test: `tests/observability/test_observability_port.py`, extend `tests/packaging/test_core_imports.py`, `tests/privacy/test_diagnostics.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] NoopObservability.record(...) never writes to disk and never opens a socket
- [ ] core/ports/features never import opentelemetry
- [ ] Event attributes validated against a closed vocabulary forbidding names/paths/URLs/IDs/tokens
- [ ] bootstrap.log rotates rather than growing unbounded
